name: A plain question resolves into a visible chain of actions
looks: A terminal panel types a plain-English question; underneath, a short sequence of structured tool-call lines streams in one at a time, each a function name with its arguments and a small result count, like a visible trace of real work being done. It closes on a plain-English confirmation line and a small workflow badge.
build: Query types on 20-30ms per character. Each tool-call line clips in top to bottom, 300-500ms apart, mono with the function name in the accent colour and the rest dimmer. The final confirmation line switches to the panel's plain body font, with a small status badge settling beside it.
sound: A soft key-tick under the typed question, a distinct tone per tool-call line landing, a clean confirm chime on the final line.
prompt: Type a plain-English question into a terminal-style panel, then stream in a short sequence of structured tool-call lines one at a time, each naming a function, its arguments and a result, before closing on one plain-English confirmation line with a small status badge, so the agent's actual work is visible rather than hidden behind a spinner.
